verses.gurmukhi: ਪੀਰ ਪੈਕੰਬਰ ਔਲੀਏ ਗੌਸ ਕੁਤਬ ਉਲਮਾਉ ਘਨੇਰੇ।
verses.translit_en: peer paika(n)bar aauale'ee gauas kutab ulamaau ghanere|

en.bdb: Many are the pirs, prophets, auliyas, gauris, qutubs and ulemas (all spiritual designations among Muslims).

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੇਖ ਮਸਾਇਕ ਸਾਦਕਾ ਸੁਹਦੇ ਔਰੁ ਸਹੀਦ ਬਹੁਤੇਰੇ।
verses.translit_en: sekh masaik saadhakaa suhadhe aauar saheedh bahutere|

en.bdb: Many shaikhs, sadiks(contented ones), and martyrs are there. Many are Qazis mullahs, maulavis (all Muslim religious and judicial designations).

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਾਜੀ ਮੁਲਾਂ ਮਉਲਵੀ ਮੁਫਤੀ ਦਾਨਸਵੰਦ ਬੰਦੇਰੇ।
verses.translit_en: kaajee mulaa(n) maulavee mufatee dhaanasava(n)dh ba(n)dhere|

en.bdb: (Similarly among the Hindus) Rsis, munis, Jain Digambars (Jain naked ascetics) and many miracle-makers knowing black magic are also known in this world.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਿਖੀ ਮੁਨੀ ਦਿਗੰਬਰਾ ਕਾਲਖ ਕਰਾਮਾਤ ਅਗਲੇਰੇ।
verses.translit_en: rikhee munee dhiga(n)baraa kaalakh karaamaat agalere|

en.bdb: Innumerable are the practising, siddhs (yogis) who publicise themselves as great persons.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਕ ਸਿਧ ਅਗਣਤ ਹੈਨਿ ਆਪ ਜਣਾਇਨਿ ਵਡੇ ਵਡੇਰੇ।
verses.translit_en: saadhak sidh aganat hain aap janain vadde vaddere|

en.bdb: None gets liberated without the true Guru without whom their ego goes on increasing further,

verses.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਸਿਝਈ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਧਦੀ ਜਾਇ ਵਧੇਰੇ।
verses.translit_en: bin gur koi na sijhiee haumai vadhadhee jai vadhere|

en.bdb: Without holy congregation, the sense of ego stares at the jtv menacingly,
I am sacrifice unto this trancendental Brahm in the form of true Guru.
